question: Which FAISS index type is used in VISTAAR, and what distance metric does it compute?
exact_evidence_spans: The baseline implementation initializes an in-memory index using faiss.IndexFlatL2 with dimension 384. This index type executes an exact, brute-force Euclidean distance search across all stored vectors.
